summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing a Nasdaq ticker symbol change from SKBL to KAZR effective June 17, 2026, ahead of its pending business combination with Cove Kaz Capital Group LLC, a critical minerals development company. The transaction was previously announced on April 30, 2026, and is expected to close before year-end 2026, subject to SEC registration statement effectiveness and regulatory approvals. The combined company will be named Kaz Resources Inc. No specific deal terms (price per share, premium, break fee) are disclosed. The filing serves as a pre-combination update, structurally similar to a SPAC de-SPAC event, with the ticker change signaling the anticipated merger. Risk-arb watchers should monitor regulatory approval timelines and S-4 effectiveness.
